answer_2.quote: We evaluate the model alignment performance on AlpacaEval 2.0 and Arena-Hard, reporting length-controlled win rate and overall win rate. Mean reward scores (RS) are also reported.

answer_3.quote: The win rate against the baseline GPT-4 Turbo model is determined based on GPT-4 Turbo evaluation. We also use ArmoRM-Llama3-8B-v0.1 as a reward model to score responses.
